texto: Past Alterna (**missade**) and perfect (**har lärt mig**) according to the time frame. Use **därför att** to explain a cause.

frases.en: Have you learned anything from that?

frases.es: Sí, he aprendido a dejar más tiempo entre los trenes.
frases.en: Yeah, I've learned to leave more time between trains.
